newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: JG Summit unit's IPO gets bourse approval.
newsitem.headline: JG Summit unit's IPO gets bourse approval.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange has approved the listing of shares of Digital Telecommunications Philippines Inc (Digitel), the telecommunications arm of conglomerate JG Summit Holdings Inc.

"It (listing) was approved with a condition that there is a one-year lock up of shares of existing shareholders and that the PSE be held free and harmless from any suit that may be brought about by those who do not agree with the lock up," PSE president Eduardo de los Angeles said on Friday.
De los Angeles said 95 percent of the shareholders had agreed to the lock up.

The bourse's rules require companies offering an IPO to show a three-year performance record but the condition is waived if existing shareholders agree not to sell their shares for a period of at least one year after the IPO.
Digitel, being a new company, could not provide a three-year record.
Digitel is planning the initial public offering of 1.21 to 1.589 billion shares at a price range of 3 to 5 persos per share.
Offering period will start late October or early November and listing date will be in October, de los Angeles said.
